question: Does a Binance Futures Bonus Voucher prove either a fully nonrecourse zero-personal-capital option or a sufficiently exact organic Futures cost overlay?

source_proved_mechanics.bonus_role: The voucher supplies free tokens in a specific cryptocurrency for use as Futures collateral on same-cryptocurrency USD-M or COIN-M Futures contracts.
source_proved_mechanics.loss_and_profit_headline: The FAQ says Futures trade losses can be offset against the bonus amount and profits generated from trading with the voucher can be withdrawn or transferred.
source_proved_mechanics.account_destination: Activation credits the reward to Futures Account.
source_proved_mechanics.principal_restriction: The voucher amount itself cannot be directly withdrawn.
source_proved_mechanics.inactivity: Binance reserves the right to revoke credits not used within 30 days.
source_proved_mechanics.source_limitation: The FAQ expressly says it is general educational information, not legal terms, may be outdated, and points to Terms of Use, Exchange Rules, Clearing Rules, procedures, contract specifications, and separate voucher terms.

free_option_gate_failures: no complete statement that commissions funding liquidation fees deficits clawbacks and every other liability are confined to bonus value
no statement that other Futures balance Spot balance collateral deposits or user assets cannot be debited encumbered or liquidated
no statement that no personal collateral deposit or additional margin can be required
no exact loss ordering between bonus value and user funds
no exact liquidation negative-balance insurance ADL recovery or deficit treatment
no complete expiry withdrawal transfer or clawback treatment proving that personal liability cannot arise
organic_cost_overlay_gate_failures: the FAQ does not define exact loss-offset ordering depletion accounting or remaining-bonus calculation
the FAQ does not define how user deposits transfers withdrawals or mixed bonus-and-personal balances affect bonus consumption or revocation
the FAQ does not prove which commissions funding liquidation fees or other costs are eligible offsets
the controlling legal terms and voucher-specific terms were not part of the prospectively frozen one-use request

adjudication.why_headline_is_insufficient: Free collateral, loss offset, and withdrawable upside do not prove a nonnegative personal-capital payoff when the controlling source does not specify loss ordering, all fee and deficit channels, liquidation, mixed balances, other-asset protection, withdrawal effects, or clawbacks.
adjudication.why_no_narrow_acceptance: The frozen narrower gate required exact eligible offset and depletion mechanics. The FAQ says losses can be offset but does not say how bonus and user balances are ordered or depleted or which fee and liability channels qualify. Post-outcome access to linked controlling terms is prohibited by the one-use decision.

next_action.retry_trigger: a material official Futures Bonus Voucher nonrecourse loss-ordering fee funding liquidation deficit mixed-balance withdrawal transfer expiry or clawback term change or a distinct prospectively frozen complete controlling legal terms package selected before economic access plus explicit signed GET-only Binance mainnet authority and an independently existing owned voucher
